description: This file defines the EmailConfigurationDao class, which interacts with EmailConfiguration entities in the database. It provides methods to retrieve and save email configuration data within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationDao
classes.description: Data access object for EmailConfiguration entities, providing methods to retrieve and store email configurations.

methods.name: getEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Fetches the email configuration from the database, returning an EmailConfiguration instance or null if none exists.

methods.name: saveEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Persists the given EmailConfiguration object to the database and returns it.
